title: The relevance cyclotron runs against a sandbox publication
description:
As Ryan, I want the relevance cyclotron run for real against a development sandbox, so that the decisions, reviews, status and recording are exercised with a real decision model before production.

Not included: production runs; creating or redeploying AWS resources; the LLM optimizer (off for the first run).

```gherkin
Feature: A sandbox run of the relevance cyclotron
  Scenario: The sandbox steering config carries the cyclotron to the sandbox bucket
    Given the publication's steering config with a relevance cyclotron block
    When the sandbox steering config is generated for a sandbox bucket
    Then the cyclotron's store snapshot prefix points at the sandbox bucket

  Scenario: A sweep decides the sandbox's pending references
    Given a sandbox with pending candidate references
    When the decide-relevance sweep runs with apply on at most 30 of them
    Then each has a recorded decision and the status snapshot is recorded
```

comments.author: home
comments.text: Stopped before --apply. Done: relevanceCyclotron block in corpora/papyrus-steering.yml (documented defaults, optimizer null, maxRequestsPerSweep 30); the sandbox steering generator now rewrites relevanceCyclotron.store.s3Prefix to the sandbox bucket (spec added, config feature 8/8). Reached the personal sandbox ppy-6b4094 (stack amplify-papyrus-ppy6b4094-sandbox-e7c1507645, AppSync 7bn4apchg5gbnbbigy6dhdoeuy, account 335163751677, read-only with AWS_PROFILE=legacy) and dry-ran the sweep: 0 pending references. Blockers: (1) the sandbox has no data at all: 0 References, 0 Messages, 0 Assignments, 0 SemanticRelationTypes; (2) its backend was deployed 2026-09-06 and predates this epic: reviewReferenceCuration has no decisionRelationId or shareable argument, so shareable reviews (and quoted explanations in the recording) cannot be recorded there; (3) no Cognito editor login exists for a browser review against it. Needed from Ryan: approval to redeploy that sandbox from develop (npx ampx sandbox --once --identifier ppy-6b4094, which updates existing AWS resources), and a source of up to 30 pending candidates (a research intake run with OpenAI web search, or a registered catalog), plus an editor user for the UI review.
